title: AWS deploy plan uses fixed argument list
scenario: Call buildDeployPlan with provider aws, a working dir, a .zip inside it, function name hcp-before-save, and an .env with AWS_REGION and AWS_PROFILE.
expected: ok is true; executable is aws; args are lambda update-function-code --function-name hcp-before-save --zip-file fileb://<abs artifact>; summary contains no credential values.

title: GCP deploy plan uses env region and source dir
scenario: buildDeployPlan with provider gcp, .env with GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_REGION=us-central1, artifact in the working dir.
expected: executable gcloud; args functions deploy <name> --gen2 --region us-central1 --source <artifact dir>; cwd is the resolved working directory.

title: Azure and native deploys are refused
scenario: buildDeployPlan with provider azure, then native, with otherwise valid inputs.
expected: ok false for both; messages say Azure deployment is unresolved / native does not use a cloud CLI; no plan or env is returned.

title: Function name with shell or flag characters is rejected
scenario: buildDeployPlan with functionNames such as 'a; rm -rf /', '--profile evil', 'a b', '$(id)', '-x', '' and a 129-char name.
expected: Every one returns ok false with the unsupported-characters message; names like 'hcp.before-save_1' are accepted (injection guard on the CLI argument).

title: Artifact outside working directory or wrong extension is refused
scenario: buildDeployPlan with artifactPath '../outside.zip', an absolute path in another dir, the working directory itself, and 'build/app.txt' inside it.
expected: Outside paths and the directory itself give 'must be a file inside the working directory'; .txt gives 'must be a .jar or .zip file'; path traversal never reaches the CLI args.

title: isContainedPath handles dotdot, equal, sibling-prefix and Windows paths
scenario: isContainedPath(root, x) for x = root, root/a.jar, root/../x, root-evil/a.jar, root/sub/../a.jar, and a different drive on win32.
expected: false for root itself, outside, and sibling-prefix dirs; true for nested files and normalized in-root paths; false for different-drive absolute paths.

title: Deploy refused when .env lacks required keys; values not echoed
scenario: buildDeployPlan aws with .env 'AWS_REGION=us-east-1' only, then AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIA... with no secret key, then ASIA... without AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.
expected: ok false with missing array naming AWS_PROFILE or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN respectively; message has no .env value. missingEnvKeys is touched in test-lca-workflow.cjs (partial).

title: Placeholder .env values do not count as present
scenario: presentEnvKeys on text with AWS_PROFILE=your-profile, AWS_REGION=<region>, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=changeme, quoted empty value, comments and lines without '='; plus a real value.
expected: Only real-valued keys are returned; placeholders, empty, quoted-empty, comment and malformed lines are skipped; key names only, never values.

title: Secrets are scrubbed from deploy output and capped
scenario: childEnv on text with quoted and unquoted values and a value of 8+ chars; then redactCommandOutput on output containing that value, an AKIA key, a password=x pair, and 5000 chars.
expected: Child env contains the values; secretValues holds only values of length 8 or more; output shows [redacted] for each secret and is cut to 2000 chars; shorter values are not scrubbed.

title: Deploy failure guidance redacts secrets and picks one next action
scenario: deployFailureGuidance on text for ExpiredToken, InvalidClientTokenId, AccessDenied/403, ResourceNotFound and an unknown error, each containing aws_secret_access_key=abc.
expected: error has [redacted] instead of the secret; nextAction differs per class and says not to paste secrets; unknown case says do not update L3 until deploy succeeds. Partly asserted in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: Package segments are sanitized and never com.example
scenario: buildJavaPackage with customerName '../Evil; Corp', typeName 'class', '9Type', '' and a blank owner; also isForbiddenGenericPackage('com.example.x').
expected: Segments contain only [a-z0-9]; keywords and leading digits get an 'n' prefix; empty becomes 'lca'; no dots or slashes leak from input; blank owner throws; com.example.* is flagged. Basic cases in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: LCA project folder slug cannot escape the LifeCycle Actions folder
scenario: lcaProjectSlug and lcaProjectDirectory with typeName '../../etc', hook 'a/b', actionName with backslashes, and all-blank parts; use a Windows-style and posix config path.
expected: Slug is lowercase [a-z0-9-] ending in -lca; no '..' or separators survive; blank parts give 'lca'; directory is under <tenantRoot>/LifeCycle Actions. Normal slugs asserted in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: Tenant root resolves for Business Config, legacy L3 and marker layouts
scenario: tenantRootFromConfig for <t>/Business Config/BusinessConfig.json, <t>/L3.reltio.json, a repo file under a dir holding .reltio-config-source.json, and a path with no marker.
expected: Returns <t> for the first two, the marker directory for the third (searches up to 8 levels), and the file's dirname when no marker is found.

title: Hook validation per object kind is case-sensitive
scenario: validateHook for entity validate, relation validate, relation beforeSave, changeRequest afterDCRSave, changeRequest beforeSave, 'beforesave', and 'bogus'; hooksForKind for each kind.
expected: Only listed combos are ok; relation validate and DCR non-afterDCRSave give specific messages; wrong case and unknown names give the case-sensitive message; relation list excludes validate, DCR list is afterDCRSave only.

title: add/filter/remove/replace produce correct proposals
scenario: Run proposeLifecycleChange for add, filter with filter string, duplicate add, remove of a string entry, remove of an action inside an {actions, filter} entry, remove last entry, remove missing, replace, and add with no action.
expected: Duplicate and missing give ok false with proposed equal to current; removing the last entry deletes the hook key; filtered entry keeps remaining actions; replace is destructive; input is never mutated; incomplete op reports incomplete.

title: L3 edit changes only lifecycleActions and preserves formatting
scenario: On the text of samples/first-test.json, findTypeJsonPath for an entity, relation, change-request URI and an unknown URI; replaceLifecycleActions with a proposal.
expected: Path is [collection, index, 'lifecycleActions'] or undefined; the edited text differs from the original only inside that type's lifecycleActions; result still parses as JSON.

title: Type and attribute lookup is exact; misses return capped suggestions
scenario: resolveObjectType with 'CourseTopics' (near miss), wrong case 'hcp', a name present in two collections, and with a kind filter; resolveAttributes with a nested path and a missing name.
expected: Exact name or label match (case-insensitive) resolves; ambiguous returns ok false with URIs; misses list at most 25 suggestions, near matches first; all missing attributes are named. Basic lookup is in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: Tenant gate blocks tenant-aware intents when disconnected and asks on multiple tenants
scenario: assessTenantConnection with tenantAware true and no locations; two tenants and no preferred; two tenants with preferredTenantId in different case; tenantAware false with none.
expected: TENANT_CONNECTION_REQUIRED with TENANT_CONNECTION_MESSAGE; multiple tenants give selected undefined and a confirm message; preferred (case-insensitive) is selected; advice mode never shows the message. Mostly in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: Git marker l3RelativePath cannot escape the marker directory
scenario: Temp dir with .reltio-config-source.json whose l3RelativePath is '../outside/BusinessConfig.json', an absolute path, 'samples/BusinessConfig.json', 'config/other.json', and one valid file.
expected: Only the valid in-directory BusinessConfig.json or L3.reltio.json that exists is returned; traversal, absolute, sample/pack and wrong-basename entries are dropped; invalid JSON marker returns [].

title: Sample and Velocity Pack configs never count as tenant L3
scenario: isTenantL3Path and isComponentConfigPath on paths under /samples/ and /velocity-packs/, a lookalike file name, backslash Windows paths, and valid layouts.
expected: Samples, packs and lookalikes return false; backslash paths are normalized; valid tenant and Business Config paths return true.

title: Tenant discovery is bounded and skips build and dependency folders
scenario: Temp tree with 25 tenant folders, a node_modules copy, and nesting deeper than 8; call discoverTenantL3(root); also from a LifeCycle Actions/<project> subfolder.
expected: Result length is capped at 20; nothing is found under node_modules/.git/dist/target/samples; depth beyond 8 is ignored; project subfolder walks up to its tenant folder.

title: Generate, deploy and L3 gates require ordered approvals
scenario: Drive createWorkflow through gate(generate/deploy/updateL3) for validation-only, register, missing requirements, unconfirmed attributes, unapproved design, non-Java, then each approval in order.
expected: Each gate stays closed until its prior confirmation is set; deploy needs DEPLOYMENT_PENDING plus approval; updateL3 also needs connectivity confirmed; messages name the missing step. Core path in test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: Approvals with questions, caveats or deploy/L3 verbs are not approval
scenario: isExplicitApproval and classifyTurn on 'yes', 'yes but wait', 'yes?', 'ok deploy it', 'yes update L3', 'What does beforeSave do?', 'Generate an LCA for HCP beforeSave'.
expected: Only plain affirmations are approvals; caveat, question and deploy/L3 forms are not; questions classify as ask; generate and deploy requests classify as generate and deploy.

title: Context file name from tenant id cannot traverse directories
scenario: projectContextFile(dir, '../../evil') and a tenant id with slashes and spaces; write and read back a context for that tenant.
expected: File name is sanitized to [a-zA-Z0-9._-] with _ replacements and stays under <dir>/.reltio/lca-context; a file whose stored tenantId or directory differs returns undefined.

title: Corrupt or mismatched context file is ignored
scenario: Write garbage JSON to the context path, then valid JSON with another workingDirectory, then valid JSON missing optional fields.
expected: Garbage and mismatched files return undefined without throwing; a partial file is merged over emptyProjectContext and implementationLanguage is forced to Java.

title: Physical config check reports presence without exposing values
scenario: assessPhysicalAccess for aws (12-digit account, role arn, region, externalId), gcp, azure (entra and oauth forms), placeholder project, undefined text and invalid JSON.
expected: present true only with complete fields; otherwise present false with a console-update instruction; output never includes config values. Partly covered at end of test-lca-workflow.cjs.

title: reltio.lcaDeploy refuses without approved context, artifact or CLI (manual)
scenario: Manual QA: with no approved context, with azure context, with no jar/zip, with aws missing on PATH, and with a failing CLI exit; run the command from the palette.
expected: Each case shows the specific message and returns ok false; ENOENT names the executable; failure output is redacted and truncated; success saves noteDeploySuccess state. Needs the VS Code host (Tier C).

title: reltio.lcaApplyLifecycleActions edits only inside workspace via WorkspaceEdit (manual)
scenario: Manual QA: approved L3_UPDATE context, run the command, cancel the modal, then accept; try a context whose workingDirectory is outside the workspace.
expected: Cancel leaves L3 untouched; accept replaces the document through WorkspaceEdit and records TENANT_CONFIG_APPLIED; out-of-workspace contexts are ignored by loadContexts. Needs VS Code host (Tier C).
